# netbox_event_rules (Data Source)

Lists event_rule objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_event_rules" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-event_rule" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: action_type, action_type__empty, action_type__ic, action_type__ie, action_type__iew, action_type__iregex, action_type__isw, action_type__n, action_type__nic, action_type__nie, action_type__niew, action_type__nisw, action_type__regex, enabled, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `event_rules` (Attributes List) The matching event_rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--event_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `event_rules`

Read-Only:

- `action_object_id` (Number) Id of the webhook or script to run.
- `action_object_type` (String) Content type of the action object: extras.webhook or extras.script.
- `action_type` (String) What the rule runs. One of: webhook, script, notification.
- `conditions` (String) Conditions the changed object must satisfy, as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule fires.
- `event_types` (Set of String) Events that trigger the rule: object_created, object_updated, object_deleted, job_started, job_completed, job_failed or job_errored.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object types the rule watches, as app-labelled content types (dcim.device).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
